fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Brigham City, 77 N Industrial Way, ~257,000 sq ft plant opened 2017. Confirmed by the red 'niagara' logo on the east office face and water-treatment silos along the building's east side in Street View (2023-08).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is fully enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence (clearly visible in Street View). The truck drive enters the fenced yard at the SW corner where the perimeter loop meets W Forest St. A controlled gate is present where the drive crosses the fence; the exact barrier element is obscured by landscaping at max zoom.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed multi-window guard booth visible at the entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Fenced/gated yard with no manned booth; a driver review explicitly describes 'a checkout system for trucking operations' - consistent with an automated / kiosk / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door row along the full north face with many trailers backed in; estimated ~34 doors from z18 imagery, flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A dedicated row of parked trailers runs along the north edge of the truck yard, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved perimeter yard and unused width inside the fence; room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane count at the SW gate could not be resolved (landscaping obstruction); estimated 1 in / 1 out, flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial area in small Brigham City, surrounded by fields - Rural per rubric (small-town industrial -> Rural).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large Niagara building; the perimeter drive loops the whole building.
